parsed.name: DP800系列可编程直流电源
parsed.name_en: DP800 Series Programmable DC Power Supply
parsed.description: 台式多路可编程直流电源，用于为实验电路、器件和原型系统提供稳定可调的电压与电流输出，并可测量输出电压、电流和功率；部分型号支持远端电压补偿。
parsed.description_en: A benchtop multi-channel programmable DC power supply used to provide stable, adjustable voltage and current to laboratory circuits, devices, and prototype systems, with measurement of output voltage, current, and power; some models support remote sensing.

actions.description: 初始化电源并默认选择通道1。
actions.description_en: Initialize the power supply and select channel 1 by default.

actions.description: 锁定或解锁前面板按键操作。
actions.description_en: Lock or unlock the front-panel controls.

actions.description: 测量当前所选通道的输出电流。
actions.description_en: Measure the output current of the currently selected channel.

actions.description: 测量当前所选通道的输出功率。
actions.description_en: Measure the output power of the currently selected channel.

actions.description: 测量当前所选通道的输出电压。
actions.description_en: Measure the output voltage of the currently selected channel.

actions.description: 开启或关闭远端电压补偿（仅部分型号支持，如DP811）。
actions.description_en: Enable or disable remote sensing (supported only on some models, such as the DP811).

actions.description: 设置当前所选通道的电流设定值。
actions.description_en: Set the current setpoint of the currently selected channel.

actions.description: 设置当前所选通道的电压设定值。
actions.description_en: Set the voltage setpoint of the currently selected channel.

actions.description: 打开或关闭当前所选通道的输出。
actions.description_en: Turn the output of the currently selected channel on or off.
